environment: Disposable native PostgreSQL 18, postgres-js pool max10, production HMAC/session/services; synthetic Bot API only

checks.name: native PostgreSQL pool uses independent backend connections
anonymous cannot list events, read details, register or read registrations
permitted list follows existing site community policy and omits payment URL
event detail exposes owned eligible children only
unknown event detail is hidden server-side
closed registration is explicit and server rejects submit
server price uses adult DB price in exact agorot
maternal child selection uses child DB price and counts participants
tampered total, arbitrary userId and chatId are rejected
foreign child ID and duplicate non-owned family keys are rejected
free event creates confirmed registration without payment attempt
double tap free event creates one registration
paid handoff uses backend amount and pending registration/immutable attempt
duplicate paid request returns same attempt and registration
changed selection cannot mutate handed-off pending order
DB price change cannot mutate existing pending attempt amount
close/return/read does not confirm payment
male can register self but cannot register existing child
my registrations never return another canonical user registration
giyur null self access and exact child policy
giyur advanced self access and exact child policy
giyur completed self access and exact child policy
separate child clarification saves stage without main questionnaire reset
male cannot gain child rights via clarification endpoint
third category cannot list, read or register even with completed profile
malformed DB price fails closed instead of parseFloat partial acceptance
missing/invalid Telegram webhook secret is 401 with no identity side effects
new bot start creates canonical identity/contact without fake email or auto subscription
bot greeting escapes dynamic HTML and has Mini App navigation, no old holiday flow
duplicate update does not send duplicate reply or create identity
replayed update ID with changed subject creates no second canonical account
bot then Mini App uses same canonical profile and preserves campaign attribution
Mini App then bot reuses same identity, never legacy tg writer
concurrent Mini App bootstrap creates one canonical user and identity
concurrent bot and Mini App bootstrap share the same canonical person
explicit subscribe and unsubscribe persist across repeated start/Mini App open
Mini App explicit opt-in is required and no arbitrary target contact accepted
group chat cannot become a canonical person
campaign mapping cannot bypass shared community authorization
non-admin cannot read audience, preview, enqueue or drain queue
CRM paginates canonical audience without technical Telegram IDs
all-filtered selection includes every server match beyond first page
audience affiliation, gender, city, Telegram, consent, profile and filter filters are server-side
selected and excluded users narrow server audience
arbitrary recipient/chat injection rejected by enqueue schema
enqueue is durable and sends nothing
enqueue retry with same request key creates no duplicate deliveries
unsubscribe between enqueue and send is skipped
worker sends plain text, marks delivered and repeated invocation does not resend
Telegram 429 respects retry_after and does not immediate resend
definite Telegram 5xx is retried with bounded backoff
Telegram forbidden marks blocked and failed; future audience excludes contact
permanent bad request fails without retry
uncertain transport outcome is unknown and not retried automatically
interrupted worker claim is unknown, never resent by another worker
parallel worker invocations deliver a due recipient at most once
max attempts terminate definite transient failure
valid future bot interaction clears transport block without restoring marketing opt-in
worker requires configured CRON_SECRET, rejects undefined bearer bypass
security logs contain no tokens, initData, PII or raw payload
release tables enable RLS and have no anon/authenticated/PUBLIC grants
manual SQL repeat preserves existing registration/payment/consent/history rows
